## Summary

- Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome.
- Identify the Jira work item and the affected module boundaries.

## Verification

- List the exact focused and complete verification commands that passed.
- Record relevant CI, database, migration, security, or architecture evidence.

## Risk and rollback

- Describe compatibility risks and the rollback procedure.
- State explicitly when no schema, dependency, or runtime configuration changes occur.

## Documentation publication check

- [ ] Status and lifecycle wording match the delivered state.
- [ ] Code snippets, commands, paths, and test counts match the reviewed implementation.
- [ ] Documentation contains project language only, with no transient execution instructions or temporary local paths.
- [ ] Diagrams and repository-relative references render and resolve.
- [ ] The pull request targets `develop`; `main` is unchanged.
